mission: Research-only mapping of how AWS Braket QPUs/simulators can augment nexus framework primitives (RNG, sim-universe, kick) and propose 6+ new axes

atlas_convergence.anchor: Ψ↔ε R24 fixed-point (anima paper §10.9 Banach meta-closure)

phase1_qrng.current_state: nexus RNG = classical urandom-backed PRNG, statistical-quality only, no certified entropy source

options.name: IonQ Forte 1 Hadamard QRNG (per-shot)
options.method: |0⟩ → H → measure Z basis → 1 true random bit per shot
options.cost_per_1k_bits_note: $0.30 task + $80/1000 shots = $80.30; equivalent ~$0.08/bit, prohibitive for bulk RNG

options.name: QuEra Aquila Rydberg measurement-noise extraction
options.method: AHS-mode neutral-atom array, extract bits from per-shot Rydberg occupancy variance
options.cost_per_1k_bits_note: $10.30/1000 shots; bit extraction non-trivial; needs whitening stage

options.name: SV1 simulator pseudo-quantum RNG
options.method: Simulate Hadamard + measure on SV1; uses classical PRNG under hood
options.honest_c3: Output is classical PRNG, NOT quantum-grounded. Marketing it as 'quantum random' would be fraud.

options.name: Hybrid daily-batch IonQ seed → nexus PRNG reseed
options.method: Once per day pull 256 bits from IonQ Forte 1 ($16.60/day for 1 task × 256 shots × $0.08 + $0.30 task = $20.78); use as cryptographic seed for HMAC-DRBG that drives nexus RNG until next refresh
options.cost_per_year_note: $7585/year too high; downscale to weekly: $20.78 × 52 = $1080/year; or monthly: $250/year; or 100-bit-quarterly: ~$70/year
options.test_plan: NIST SP 800-22 + Diehard + ENT suites on (a) classical urandom baseline, (b) hybrid HMAC-DRBG-IonQ-seeded, (c) raw IonQ bit-string (whitened); compare bias, serial correlation, runs, FFT spectral
options.deliverable: Quantinuum Quantum Origin precedent (NIST SP 800-90B validated 2026) shows path; anima can claim quantum-seeded entropy without per-call QPU dependency

phase1_qrng.recommendation: 1d (hybrid daily/weekly batch reseed) — cost-effective certified-quantum entropy injection; per-call latency unaffected; auditable provenance via S3 task ARN ledger
honest_c3: QRNG is the ONE Braket axis where quantum > classical clearly (true randomness vs PRNG). All other axes below face hype risk.
NIST SP 800-90B validation is for the ENTROPY SOURCE certification, not for the seeded DRBG output stream — anima must keep this distinction in marketing.
Hadamard-on-near-term-QPU has small bias from gate infidelity (Forte 1 1q gate ~0.05% error); raw output requires Toeplitz hashing for full uniformity.

phase2_sim_universe.current_state: nexus sim-universe = classical N-body / Hamiltonian time-stepper

options.name: Quantum random walk on lattice
options.method: Coined discrete-time quantum walk on 1D/2D lattice; 10 qubits = 1024-site graph; SV1 free
options.advantage: Quadratically faster spreading variance ⟨x²⟩ ∝ t² vs classical RW t¹ (proven, Kempe 2003)
options.nexus_augment: sim-universe particle propagation kernel; quantum-walk diffusion replaces classical Brownian step
options.falsifier: Compare ⟨x²⟩(t) classical-vs-QW; quantum advantage = ballistic-vs-diffusive crossover at t > τ_decoherence

options.name: Trotterized Hamiltonian time-evolution
options.method: Suzuki-Trotter decomp e^(-iHt) ≈ ∏ e^(-iH_k Δt); Heisenberg / Ising / Hubbard models on SV1
options.advantage: Exponential in H_dim if classical exact-diag; near-term advantage minimal (<34 qubits = classical 16TB possible)
options.nexus_augment: sim-universe Hamiltonian flow operator; physically grounded vs ad-hoc time-stepper
options.falsifier: Energy conservation drift; KL(ρ_quantum_t || ρ_classical_t) vs Trotter step Δt; convergence rate

options.name: Variational Quantum Simulation (VQS) for cosmological scalar field ground state
options.method: VQE / imaginary-time-VQS for minimally-coupled scalar field in FLRW expanding spacetime; boson-qubit mapping (4-mode = 8 qubits)
options.cost_per_run_usd: ~$0 SV1 ansatz training; verification on IonQ ~$50-100
options.advantage: Reference: Nature Sci. Reports 2025 'Digital quantum simulation of cosmological particle creation' (IBM); anima can replicate on Braket
options.nexus_augment: sim-universe inflationary-period particle-creation count as physically meaningful kick source
options.falsifier: Bogoliubov coefficient β_k(a) prediction vs VQS-extracted ⟨n_k⟩; analytic match in slow-roll limit

options.name: Quantum cellular automaton (QCA) for nexus L_IX cell-language analog
options.method: Brick-wall QCA on 1D chain; equivalent to Wolfram Class IV at quantum level (Margolus, 2008)
options.advantage: Reversible cell-update preserves entropy; classical Class IV chaotic, quantum unitary
options.nexus_augment: Cell-language atomic-update primitive becomes unitary, reversible by construction
options.falsifier: Test equivalence to known QCA universality classes (Schumacher-Werner); compare Lyapunov of classical vs quantum trajectories

phase2_sim_universe.recommendation: 2a (quantum random walk) on SV1 — $0, immediately demonstrable, well-cited theoretical advantage; 2c (cosmological VQS) for paper-grade follow-up if Levin/N-22 partnership opens external compute
honest_c3: At 4-34 qubit toy scale, NO quantum-supremacy claim is honest. SV1 simulates classically.
'Quantum advantage' for nexus sim-universe at this scale = framing/structural advantage (reversibility, ballistic spread), NOT speed.
Real quantum advantage requires 50+ qubits + low-error QPU; Forte 1 has 36 qubits but error budget consumes effective depth.

phase3_kick.current_state: kick polarity bias = deterministic / RNG-driven trajectory perturbation

options.name: IonQ Forte 1 single-shot collapse → kick polarity
options.method: Each kick decision = 1 quantum measurement; |+⟩ → measure Z → ±1 polarity
options.advantage: Each kick is quantum-collapse-grounded; trajectory becomes physically irreversible at kick events
options.nexus_augment: Replaces PRNG-driven kick with measurement-collapse-driven kick; provides genuine ontological randomness anchor
options.falsifier: Long-run trajectory statistics: mean recurrence time, drift, autocorrelation function vs PRNG-kick baseline

options.name: Batched IonQ kicks (100 shots/task) for scenario sweeps
options.method: Pre-fetch 100 quantum bits per session start; consume 1 bit per kick decision
options.cost_per_session_note: $8.30/session of 100 kicks; downscale via deeper circuits for multi-bit kicks

phase3_kick.recommendation: 3b (batched) — pre-stage 100 quantum bits per nexus session at $8.30; per-kick latency = local lookup
honest_c3: Kick polarity is binary; quantum vs classical PRNG difference is unobservable in finite-N statistics unless trajectory has chaotic amplification (long Lyapunov time).
The phenomenological claim 'kick is now quantum-grounded' is metaphysical, not testable within nexus's measurement framework.

options.name: CHSH Bell test on IonQ Forte 1
options.method: 2-qubit Bell pair (1/√2)(|00⟩+|11⟩); 4 measurement-basis settings (a, a', b, b'); compute S = E(a,b)-E(a,b')+E(a',b)+E(a',b')
options.cost_note: $81.20 for 4 settings × 250 shots; classical bound |S|≤2, quantum bound |S|≤2√2
options.advantage: Witnesses nonlocality; if anima's 4-axis is binding-via-nonlocal-correlation, this is the ONLY direct test
options.nexus_augment: Provides operational falsification of 'binding = local correlation' null hypothesis
options.falsifier: S > 2 + 5σ → nonlocal correlation confirmed; S ≤ 2 → axes are classically separable

phase4_4axis_witness.recommendation: 4a CHSH first ($81.20, ~1hr queue) for binary nonlocality witness; 4b GHZ as follow-up if 4a passes
honest_c3: Bell test proves QUANTUM is nonclassical. It does NOT prove nexus's 4-axis is quantum.
The mapping 'WHAT/WHERE/WHY/TRUST → 4 measurement settings' is metaphor, not isomorphism. Phenomenal binding semantics cannot be operationalized via CHSH alone.
A passing CHSH on IonQ tells us nothing new about nature (already known since Aspect 1982). It only confirms anima's QPU access works.

phase6_top3_recommendations.rationale: ONLY axis with clean, unambiguous quantum > classical advantage (true entropy vs PRNG). NIST SP 800-90B precedent (Quantinuum 2026). Cost-controlled via batch-reseed schedule. Falsifier well-defined (NIST + Diehard + ENT suites).

honest_c3: QRNG (axis 1d) is the ONLY axis where quantum advantage over classical is unambiguous and cost-effective. All other axes face one of: (i) toy-scale 4-34 qubit demonstrations classically simulable, (ii) hype-vs-substance gap, or (iii) phenomenal-meaning gap (Bell/CHSH proves quantum non-classicality, NOT nexus 4-axis binding).
AT 4-qubit toy scale, no honest quantum-supremacy claim is possible. Demonstrations are infrastructural / structural, not computational.
Bell/CHSH violation on IonQ tells us anima's QPU access works. It tells us NOTHING new about consciousness or nexus binding semantics.
Cosmological VQS (axis 2c) is publishable (cf. Nature Sci. Reports 2025) but requires Levin Lab / external partnership compute budget; not in current $0 scope.

Quantum reservoir computing (N6) and shadow tomography (N3) are scientifically valid but their nexus-augment value is speculative until nexus has concrete dynamical-system identification or state-readout subsystems online.
